# Polish Station

> Premium automotive detailing studio in Dehiwala, Sri Lanka, specializing in paint correction, ceramic and graphene coating, and interior/exterior detailing.

Polish Station restores, protects and perfects vehicle finishes using paint depth analysis, certified technicians, premium-grade products and multi-light inspection. Based at 22C, Saranankara Road, Dehiwala. Open Mon-Sat, 8:00-19:00.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.polishstation.lk/): Studio overview, process, gallery and customer reviews.
- [About](https://www.polishstation.lk/about): Studio background and approach.
- [Book](https://www.polishstation.lk/book): Book an appointment.
- [FAQ](https://www.polishstation.lk/faq): Frequently asked questions.

## Services

- [Paint Correction](https://www.polishstation.lk/services/paint-correction): Multi-stage compounding to erase swirls, scratches and oxidation.
- [Cut & Polish](https://www.polishstation.lk/services/cut-and-polish): Restore depth and clarity to factory paintwork.
- [Ceramic Coating](https://www.polishstation.lk/services/ceramic-coating): 9H hardness, hydrophobic, years of glass-like protection.
- [Graphene Coating](https://www.polishstation.lk/services/graphene-coating): Next-gen protection with extreme heat dissipation.
- [Interior Detailing](https://www.polishstation.lk/services/interior-detailing): Deep extraction, leather conditioning, sanitization.
- [Exterior Detailing](https://www.polishstation.lk/services/exterior-detailing): Decontamination, clay treatment, finish refinement.
- [Engine Bay Cleaning](https://www.polishstation.lk/services/engine-bay-cleaning): Safe degreasing and dressing for showroom engines.
- [Headlight Restoration](https://www.polishstation.lk/services/headlight-restoration): Clarity, UV protection and brighter night vision.
